evacuation.name: Sri Maha Mariamman Temple Bukit Subang

lines.construction: We drive past every weekend to see how many floors are up. I plan the school run around the site now.
lines.handover: Boxes everywhere, but it feels like home already. My little one made a friend in the lift.
lines.daily_life: Just 9 min walk to Urban Park, easy with the children.

lines.construction: Every month I check the progress photos, so excited. I tell my friends about it over teh tarik.
lines.handover: Moving in is tiring, my back is aching. My children helped carry everything up.
lines.daily_life: Just 9 min walk to Urban Park, easy for me.

lines.construction: Hard to imagine living there while it is all scaffolding. My morning drive goes right past the crane.
lines.handover: Boxes everywhere, but it feels like home already. The commute from here looks manageable.
lines.daily_life: Lakeside Mall (Car Park B) is only 7 min walk from home, I go there most evenings.

lines.construction: Rainy days slow the work, hope our handover is not late. I plan my route before I leave home.
lines.handover: We all ran straight to the window when we came in. First I will learn the way to the lift.
lines.daily_life: Can get to Lakeside Mall (Car Park B), but parts of the way are not checked for a wheelchair yet.

lines.construction: Our family is saving up for the renovation while they build. I keep an eye on which paths stay open.

lines.daily_life: Can get to Klinik Siti, but parts of the way are not checked for a wheelchair yet.
